deviations.why: The register holds no entry with topic_id 5.2 and the work order carries no MISCON slot, so no discrimination card was required. The confusion examiners most plausibly record here - absolute poverty read as relative poverty or the reverse - is taught as a boundary in the definitions block (CU-0455-5.2.1, claim CLM-0455-5.2-003) rather than as a MISCON card, since no examiner-evidenced entry exists for this topic.

The brief names parts of 1 + 2 + 4 + 6 marks, which sums to 13, so a 1-mark State part was added to reach the stated 14 marks while keeping the named part types and tariffs intact, as the sibling topics did.
